title: Passion, Pain and Righteousness
summary: The three tenets of the Devil-Tigers.

claims.text: However they differ on the road to the Hundred Clouds, all Devil-Tigers hold three great imperatives central to their Dharma: Passion, Pain and Righteousness.

title: The August Body of Sagacious Devils

claims.text: One of three traditional Devil-Tiger institutions, the August Body is an independent board that certifies each Devil-Tiger's competence through demanding tests.
It traces its roots to the confusion after the Dharma system was founded and the Five Emperors banned large Devil-Tiger churches.

Ban Ren Guei, the half-demon people, are born of a succubus-like Bane and a sleeping mortal; they come into the world as bakemono, wicked by birth and loyal to the master of the Bane that bore them, or to the Devil-Tiger who caused their making.

title: Societies of Brigands
summary: The vanished third leg of Devil-Tiger society.

claims.text: The third traditional institution, the Society of Brigands and Decadent Dynasty Toppling Devils, was a series of mobs of low-born jina and disciples that rose in times of great unrest, when shen could act more openly; it is not expected to return.
Devil-Tiger bodhisattvas, some of them Sagacious Devils, would sometimes proclaim such a rising after careful ethical and astrological reckoning.
